description: A plus-size Black woman with long blonde hair wearing a colorful floral one-piece swimsuit stands in a shallow illuminated pool, smiling and facing a bearded white man with curly brown hair. The man wears matching floral swim trunks, blue water shoes, and a yellow scuba tank backpack, looking at her with a slight smile. They are surrounded by glowing jellyfish, bubbles, and string lights against a dark underwater background with small fish visible.
title: Jellyfish Pool Encounter
prompt: A vibrant cartoon illustration of a curvy Black woman with long flowing blonde hair and a bearded Caucasian man with curly brown hair and beard standing in a shallow glowing pool at night. She wears a purple, pink and yellow floral one-piece swimsuit, he wears matching floral swim trunks, blue water shoes and carries a yellow and black scuba tank on his back. They face each other smiling with fists gently raised. The scene is filled with large translucent glowing purple and pink jellyfish floating in the dark blue water, air bubbles, colorful string lights hanging above, and a small orange fish. Warm and cool lighting, whimsical underwater fantasy atmosphere, smooth cel-shaded digital painting style.
